prior_evidence: ../final-validation/RESULTS.md: updated hot-query p99 +11.5%, p50 +11.0%; 32 samples per group, code-layout and host-noise confounders unresolved
observed_mechanism: capture_planned_query clones bounded changed document IDs into a per-query hash set; dense leaf selection hashes those strings for each candidate row. Captured slot membership is also built even when no dense delta is present.
hypothesis: Represent excluded base-index owners by allocation identity, retaining the first replaced owner for each changed ID until index retirement; avoid per-query String clones and per-row string hashing without an unbounded cache. Skip slot membership construction when no dense delta needs merging.
invariants: Exact canonical scores and full ordered results unchanged
First base owner retained across repeated replacement, delete/recreate and changed chunk counts
Index and captured Arc owners prevent address reuse for indexed rows
Clear delta state on index publication or overflow; old captured queries retain their own index and exclusions
Existing 128-document, 1024-chunk and 64 KiB ID bounds remain unchanged; no extra document ownership retained
validation: Existing dense/search correctness suites plus repeated replacement/delete/recreate regression
Paired baseline/candidate probes reuse frozen 10k-row 16-dimensional corpus and exhaustive ordered-result oracle
Rotate execution order over independent rounds; record capture/execution, requested bytes, mutation/train/reopen and host conditions
Increase hot-query samples beyond the original 32 before interpreting tails; report empirical quantiles, never population-tail guarantees
Run after unrelated local builds and fsync-heavy tests finish; local/offline only; no model downloads or paid APIs
acceptance: Demonstrated reduction in changed-ID capture allocations
No sustained median hot-query regression over 5% across independent rounds; investigate variability before retaining optimization
Report any residual p99 limitation rather than claim the historical regression resolved
rejection: Reject or revise the candidate if owner-lifetime invariants fail, retained memory grows without bound, or equivalent-workload measurements do not support its cost/benefit.
scope_limit: This experiment does not establish competitive superiority, high-dimensional scaling, or production latency bounds.

sampling.oracle: exhaustive ordered result equality for every timed query; oracle outside timed interval
